speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You are here for evaluation of gait and limb ataxia, and you have a significant medical history. To begin, can you describe the onset and progression of your balance and coordination problems?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description; the "drunk-like" gait and right-sided clumsiness suggest a cerebellar issue. Is this ataxia constant, or does it worsen significantly when you look around or take your eyes off the target? Also, have you noticed any other symptoms like speech changes, double vision, or numbness?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain with contrast.
